Right of First Refusal and Co-Sale Agreement, June 21, 2011
If a founder wants to sell shares, the company has the first right to buy them, and
then the investors.
Notice of a proposed sale must be given 45 days before it. The company has 15 days
to answer, and the investors 15 days after that.
An investor that does not buy may join the sale pro rata.
